title: Shipbuilding's Slippery Slope
summary:
1 Tanker Orderbook by Sector
Kicking the can down the road: In general, it is difficult to engender sympathy for shipowners. To market insiders, the plight might be somewhat easier, but one could make the case that market cyclicality is largely within their collective control. Although demand and trade growth are dictated by forces well beyond the confines of offices and board rooms, the booms and busts of the market are largely vessel supply related.
